cases.q: What has he done for accessibility?
cases.answer: Craig has worked with accessible UI since building UI libraries held to WCAG for clients. He ensures his current site is held to WCAG 2.2 AA standards, using an automated suite that checks the site after every deploy and every week to prevent regressions. This suite includes axe-core checks for every page state, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, reflow, and motion control. He also implements design tokens to ensure text contrast meets a 4.5:1 ratio and ensures controls have sufficient target sizes. See accessibility.md.
